name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 31 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2026-07-10, at wavelengths from 1.23 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
